label: AbiV system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiV locus whose encoded AbiV protein can restrict 936-like or c2-like lactococcal phages by interfering with late phage DNA maturation.
observations: AbiV branch under abortive infection system; distinct from the individual abiV gene, the AbiV protein, the DefenseFinder HMM profile, the orf1 pre-name, pGhost9::ISS1 activation events, the pJH2 expression vector, 936/c2/P335 phage specificity, unresolved AbiV phage triggers, host targets, c2-specific outputs, phage-escape routes, other Abi systems, and generic abortive infection systems.
